statements.hypotheses: K=Q(sqrt(-3)); every finite-order Hecke character, arbitrary conductor.
statements.conclusion: No zeros for Re(s)>11/12 at every height; hence all Dirichlet L-functions, including zeta.
sup |pi(x;q,a)-Li(x)/phi(q)| << x^(11/12) log x, absolute effective constant.
